comparison.objective: Sort only cast red, blue, and blank ballots into their matching trays.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic selection and token pick-and-place while excluding an uncast ballot.
comparison.success_condition: All three cast tokens in correct trays; any placement of the outside ballot in a tray invalidates success.
comparison.reason: Tests provenance-aware sorting, not precision tool alignment, impact regulation, fracture, or retained-insert protection.
